bull.b: Sustained very high gross margins indicate a structurally profitable product architecture and pricing power for ADCs. This supports scalable unit economics as sales scale, enabling potential conversion of revenue growth into healthier operating profits if SG&A and R&D remain controlled.

A positive pivotal LOTIS‑5 readout materially de-risks regulatory pathway and enables sBLA discussions, compendia listing and lifecycle expansion. This structural clinical validation can open broader label opportunities and justify commercial investment and partnerships over multiple years.

Demonstrated expense reductions plus a stated cash runway into 2028 improve funding visibility and operational optionality. Persistent cost discipline and defined runway reduce immediate financing pressure and give time to execute regulatory/commercial milestones that can transform long-term revenue prospects.

bear.b: Negative equity combined with rising debt is a lasting financial constraint that limits balance sheet flexibility, increases refinancing/dilution risk, and can impede strategic investments or M&A. It makes the company dependent on external capital, raising execution risk over the medium term.

Chronic negative operating and free cash flow means the business remains funding-dependent absent material revenue inflection. Even with improved burn, continued outflows force reliance on equity/debt raises or partnerships, which can dilute shareholders and constrain long-term strategic choices.

Elevated serious/Grade 5 events in older patients pose a structural hurdle for labeling, physician uptake and reimbursement. Safety signals can limit indicated populations, require risk‑mitigation strategies, or prompt label warnings that materially temper commercial potential even if efficacy gains are confirmed.
